name: medvault
description: Privacy-preserving medical records: AES-256-GCM encrypted records hidden inside scans with reversible watermarking, patient-controlled access and a tamper-evident audit log.
author: Vishwanathan R <mail@vishwanathan.dev> (https://vishwanathan.dev)

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web
